channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Por que o fim da escala 6×1 é importante para o governo e para a democracia
item.description: The debate on ending the 6×1 work schedule in the Senate marks the most significant labor rights change in Brazil in 38 years, backed by 70% public support and approved in the Chamber of Deputies by a large majority. Driven by the VAT Movement, the issue forces lawmakers to choose between business interests and electoral pressure in an election year, reflecting a global capitalist crisis defined by labor precarization and economic power concentration.

item.title: Nunes Marques endossa suspeita sobre pesquisa
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques of the TSE suspended, by liminar decision, the AtlasIntel poll showing declining voter intentions for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after the revelation of his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro. The move endorsed suspicions raised by Bolsonarists about the poll's validity, sparking controversy over potential electoral interference.

item.title: Atlas/Bloomberg diz que năo cometeu contaminaçăo metodológica após pesquisa suspensa pelo TSE
item.description: Atlas/Bloomberg denied committing ideological bias in a poll that showed negative impact on Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign after leaked audio revealed him asking for money from banker Daniel Vorcaro. Although the poll was suspended by the TSE, the firm stated it adhered to strict methodological standards. The incident sparked debate over impartiality in electoral polling during the 2026 cycle.

item.title: O que diz a AtlasIntel após suspensão de pesquisa que mostra queda de Flávio
item.description: AtlasIntel stated it respects the TSE's decision to suspend the dissemination of its poll showing Flávio Bolsonaro losing ground against Lula, but will defend the poll's legality and methodological rigor. The firm denies influencing respondents, noting the contested audio was played after the questionnaire, thus causing no contamination, and that the downward trend was also observed by other pollsters.

item.title: Crusoé: AtlasIntel responde a Nunes Marques
item.description: Polling institute AtlasIntel released a statement in response to a preliminary injunction by Kassio Nunes Marques, president of the TSE, which suspended the release of an electoral poll. The company said it is fully cooperating with the Electoral Justice, providing all requested clarifications and methodological information about the study.

item.title: A resposta da AtlasIntel ao TSE após pesquisa suspensa
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques suspended the publication of an AtlasIntel poll on Flávio Bolsonaro after claims that an audio clip of his conversation with Daniel Vorcaro was played to respondents. AtlasIntel CEO Andrei Roman defended the institute’s credibility, stating it has faced criticism from both left and right when results disfavored political groups. The poll showed Bolsonaro trailing Lula in a potential runoff, and AtlasIntel claims the audio was only shown after the main questionnaire ended, without influencing responses.

item.title: Flávio defende “modelo Bukele” e a construção de novos presídios
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) advocated for adopting El Salvador's 'Bukele model' in Brazil, calling for harsher penalties against criminals and the construction of new prisons to reduce violence. He cited a 97% drop in homicides in El Salvador since 2019 as evidence and reiterated that groups like PCC and Comando Vermelho should be designated as terrorist organizations. The remarks were made at the Brasil de Ideias Mulher – Special Elections event, organized by Grupo Voto.

item.title: Em evento com empresárias, Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Lula parece 'chefe do PCC'
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) claimed that President Lula (PT) appears to be the 'leader of the PCC' due to the Brazilian government's opposition to the U.S. designation of the PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations. The statement was made during an event with businesswomen on Monday.

item.title: A resposta do AtlasIntel após Kassio derrubar pesquisa que mostra Flávio Bolsonaro em queda
item.description: AtlasIntel defended the methodological validity of its poll showing Flávio Bolsonaro down seven points against Lula, despite a temporary injunction by TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques blocking its publication following a request from the Bolsonaro-aligned pre-candidate. The institute stated the audio of Bolsonaro’s conversation with Daniel Vorcaro was presented only after the main questionnaire was completed, for analytical purposes only, and expressed confidence that the TSE plenary would uphold the study’s technical rigor and legality.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro critica ‘canetadas’ do STF e sugere ligações de Dino e Lula com o crime organizado
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) criticized Supreme Court (STF) decisions as 'pen strokes' creating legal insecurity, advocating for reducing the age of criminal responsibility and greater congressional support for structural reforms. He praised the U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations and suggested that President Lula and Justice Minister Flávio Dino have ties to organized crime, accusing the government of failing to act against money laundering by these criminal groups.

item.title: “Depois de cada ataque injusto, a AtlasIntel se consolidou”
item.description: AtlasIntel CEO Andrei Roman defended the polling institute after the TSE suspended the release of a presidential survey, claiming that unjust attacks on its reputation have only strengthened it over time.

item.title: Justiça determina novo bloqueio de pagamentos do PL a publicitário de Flávio
item.description: A São Paulo court has ordered a new block on payments from the PL party to publicist Eduardo Fischer, consultant for Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign, over a R$108 million debt claimed by an investment fund since 2017. The ruling requires the PL and Flávio to deposit owed amounts into a judicial account, disclose prior payments, and submit the contract, following a prior block over a separate R$114 million debt.

item.title: Moraes homologa acordo com deputado do PL e encerra ação penal
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes approved a non-prosecution agreement with federal deputy Sargento Rodrigues (PL-MG), who was charged by the Prosecutor General's Office for inciting crime and criminal association related to the January 8 anti-democratic demonstrations. The agreement includes 150 hours of community service, a R$5,000 fine, mandatory attendance in a 12-hour course on democracy and the rule of law, and a ban from social media, sparing him a potential 3 years and 6 months prison sentence.

item.title: Nunes Marques suspende pesquisa que perguntou sobre Flávio Bolsonaro e Vorcaro
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques suspended an AtlasIntel poll linking Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to the Banco Master scandal and Daniel Vorcaro, arguing the question sequence and wording could induce biased responses on voting intentions. The poll, released in May, showed a five-point drop in the PL pre-candidate’s 2026 presidential vote intentions. Marques ordered the institute to submit technical documentation within two days, citing the CEO’s admitted political bias in a CNN Brasil interview as further evidence of methodological compromise.

item.title: Carol Cabrino, esposa de Marquinhos, relembra investidas antes de conhecer jogador: 'Me caçando de todo jeito'
item.description: Carol Cabrino reveals that footballer Marquinhos persistently pursued her on social media for six months before she responded, despite her shyness and concerns about his reputation as a womanizer. They met in 2014 when both were 19 and have been married since 2016, now living in Paris. The story was shared in the Globoplay documentary 'As convocadas', which follows the partners of Brazilian national team players ahead of the 2026 World Cup.

item.title: Campanha de Lula diz que decisão de Nunes Marques sobre pesquisa abre precedente perigoso
item.description: Lula’s campaign expressed concern over a decision by Kassio Nunes Marques, president of the TSE, to suspend a poll showing declining voter intentions for Flávio Bolsonaro. The PT team warned the ruling sets a dangerous precedent for the freedom to disclose electoral data and could be used to pressure polling institutes. The incident occurred on August 6, 2026, at 15:31, raising alarms about the independence of the electoral process.

item.title: Por que PCC e CV ligam o alerta máximo das autoridades nas eleições de 2026
item.description: Criminal organizations such as PCC and CV are seeking to finance and infiltrate candidates in the 2026 Brazilian elections to expand their territorial control and influence public policy, aiming to secure state protection, facilitate money laundering, and alter legislation in their favor. Federal and state authorities have launched operations to block candidatures linked to crime and ensure free voting, as nearly 30 million Brazilians live under the dominance of these groups. The Senate’s CPI confirmed that organized crime does not merely seek to hold office, but to capture the State through institutional access and protection.

item.title: EBC confirma saída de Datena da TV Brasil para disputar eleições
item.description: Journalist and presenter José Luiz Datena ended his contract with EBC after six months at TV Brasil and Rádio Nacional to run in the 2026 elections. His departure was driven by PSB's efforts to nominate him as a federal deputy candidate for São Paulo, in line with electoral law requiring communicators to leave media outlets by June 30 of election year. Datena previously ran unsuccessfully for mayor of São Paulo in 2024 under the PSDB.

item.title: Dino mantém suspenso julgamento sobre sucessão no Rio após decisão do TSE
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino has kept the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial succession case on hold, awaiting the publication of a new TSE ruling after rejecting the Electoral Prosecutor's Office appeal. The case, stalled for two months, was previously leaning 4-1 toward indirect elections, but Dino seeks to resolve contradictions between the TSE's judgment and its ruling to determine whether the election should be direct or indirect. With the June 21 deadline for supplementary elections approaching, Rio remains under interim governance by Justice Ricardo Couto.

item.title: O que disse diretor da AtlasIntel sobre pesquisa que foi suspensa por Nunes Marques
item.description: The AtlasIntel poll released on May 19 showed Lula with 47% and Flávio Bolsonaro with 34% in the first round, suggesting the scandal involving the senator and Daniel Vorcaro negatively impacted his campaign. The poll was suspended by Nunes Marques following a request from Flávio's defense, which claimed methodological contamination from playing controversial audio, though AtlasIntel asserts the procedure was separated from the electoral questionnaire to avoid bias.

item.title: Em meio à crise da carne, Lula evita evento do agro e escala Alckmin
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva avoided attending the Bahia Farm Show amid the beef crisis, following hostile reception in 2023 when he was booed and called a 'thief'. He sent Vice President Geraldo Alckmin in his place, who attended alongside Bahia Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president in 2026, confirmed his presence at the event and linked the EU’s ban on Brazilian beef exports to 'Lula’s problem' that will need to be resolved in the 2026 elections.

item.title: TCU arquiva representação de Flávio Bolsonaro contra ex-nora de Lula
item.description: The TCU dismissed a representation filed by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro against Carla Ariane Trindade, former daughter-in-law of President Lula, due to insufficient evidence to investigate alleged irregularities in MEC fund transfers to Life Tecnologia Educacional. The court found no documentation to individualize facts, identify contracts, or assign responsibility, and noted the funds originated from Fundeb (not federal), referring the matter to the São Paulo State Court of Accounts. The PF is investigating the case under Operation Coffee Break, alleging overpricing and diversion of R$ 70 million in school kits.

item.title: Alckmin: governo quer que UE recoloque Brasil na lista de fornecedores
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin said the Brazilian government will make a major effort to resolve the issue of Brazilian beef being removed from the European Union’s list of approved suppliers, emphasizing the sector’s importance to the national economy.

item.title: Mulheres se reúnem com Flávio em evento que gerou polêmica com Jair. Vídeo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro attended the Ciclo Brasil de Ideias – Women event in São Paulo as the sole male panelist, contrasting with the 2022 edition which featured only male speakers. He was accompanied by his wife Fernanda Bolsonaro and PL deputies, alongside other invited figures. Potential presidential candidates Lula, Caiado, and Zema were invited but no dates have been confirmed.

item.title: Nunes Marques repete manobra de Moraes ao aceitar pleito de Flávio
item.description: In his first 30 days as TSE president, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques implemented centralizing measures akin to those of his predecessor Alexandre de Moraes, potentially creating tensions within the court during the 2026 presidential election year. His acceptance of Flávio Bolsonaro’s plea indicates continuity in the tribunal’s decision-making line, despite criticism over power concentration.

item.title: Big techs movem artilharia pesada no STF para barrar decretos de Lula
item.description: The STF is set to rule on nine petitions filed by Google and Meta challenging Lula’s decrees that deepen platforms’ liability for illegal online content, such as racism, homophobia, and incitement to suicide. The decrees empower the ANPD to monitor compliance and impose sanctions, including fines and service suspensions. The shift to a virtual plenary hearing has raised alarms among big techs, who fear a rushed, unfavorable outcome.

item.title: TSE suspende pesquisa que registrou queda de Flávio após “Dark Horse”
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques suspended the publication of an AtlasIntel poll showing declining voter intention for Flávio Bolsonaro, after the PL party challenged the questionnaire for alleged bias, citing questions linking Flávio to a financial fraud scheme at Banco Master before voting intention was measured. The poll, registered as BR-06939/2026, was conducted May 13–18 and released May 19, shortly after audio emerged of Flávio requesting funds from Banco Master’s founder Daniel Vorcaro for the 'Dark Horse' film. The ruling is preliminary and pending review by the TSE plenary.

item.title: Renovação da CNH automática já está valendo: saiba como obter
item.description: Automatic renewal of the National Driver's License (CNH) is now active for drivers registered in the National Positive Driver Registry (RNPC) with no point-based traffic violations in the past 12 months. Signed by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, the measure has already benefited 2 million drivers and saved R$ 854.8 million, requiring only physical and mental fitness exams, with restrictions for those over 70 and licenses expired over 30 days.

item.title: Nunes Marques suspende pesquisa AtlasIntel que mostrou queda de Flávio
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques issued a preliminary injunction suspending the release of an AtlasIntel poll showing declining voter intentions for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro following controversy over the sponsorship of the film Dark Horse by banker Daniel Vorcaro. The measure aims to prevent the dissemination of potentially harmful data while the poll’s legitimacy is under review. The story was first reported by O Antagonista.

item.title: Alckmin representa Lula na abertura da Bahia Farm Show 2026
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) represented President Lula at the opening of the 2026 Bahia Farm Show in Luís Eduardo Magalhães (BA), announcing the Move Agrícola program with R$14 billion in credit for agricultural machinery and the Move Caminhões program with R$21.1 billion for road fleet renewal, alongside Neoenergia Coelba’s R$24 billion investment plan in Bahia through 2030. The event also served as a political showcase for the 2026 presidential race, bringing together ministers, lawmakers, and potential presidential candidates.

item.title: Datena decide encerrar contrato com a EBC para ser candidato
item.description: Journalist José Luiz Datena has decided to terminate his contract with EBC to run as a candidate in the 2026 elections. He was hired at the beginning of 2026 and hosted daily and weekly programs on Rádio Nacional and TV Brasil, but will leave the broadcaster by June 30, the last date allowed for pre-candidates to appear on air. Datena has affiliated with the PSB and intends to run for federal deputy from São Paulo.

item.title: Reação do PT a Nikolas Ferreira abre a guerra digital das eleições de 2026
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian presidential race will be dominated by social media, according to political scientist Rodrigo Prando. Parties like the PT and PL are strengthening their digital strategies, with the PT promoting new figures such as Pedro Rousseff and the PL relying on Nikolas Ferreira as a key mobilizer. Platform algorithms favor emotionally charged content — anger, fear, indignation — making confrontational and aggressive debate formats more likely to go viral.

item.title: Nunes Marques suspende pesquisa que apontou queda de Flávio Bolsonaro após diálogos com Vorcaro
item.description: TSE President Kássio Nunes Marques suspended the publication of an AtlasIntel poll showing a six-point drop in Flávio Bolsonaro's voting intention against Lula, following a request from the PL party. The interim decision was based on suspicions of voter induction in the poll's questions, which were released days after an audio surfaced in which Flávio sought funds from banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse'. The measure will be submitted to a referendum by the full Electoral Court.

item.title: Nunes Marques ao suspender pesquisa da AtlasIntel: "Indício de manipulação"
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques suspended the release of the AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll after identifying indications of methodological manipulation, particularly due to the sequential order of questions and negatively charged language that could induce responses against Flávio Bolsonaro. The ruling, in response to a request from the Liberal Party, cited concerns over 'contamination of responses' and emphasized the need to safeguard electoral integrity by verifying the survey's methodology before publication.

item.title: Nunes Marques suspende divulgação de pesquisa AtlasIntel com áudio de Flávio
item.description: TSE President Nunes Marques partially granted Flávio Bolsonaro's defense request by suspending further dissemination of an AtlasIntel presidential poll. The ban on new publication, promotion, or republication remains in effect until the TSE plenary reviews the case, citing concerns that playing an audio of Bolsonaro requesting funds from banker Daniel Vorcaro may have influenced voters. AtlasIntel must submit technical documentation defending its methodology, while the defense claims the audio exposure caused irreparable harm by associating the candidate with the banker.

item.title: Nunes Marques suspende pesquisa eleitoral que usou áudio de Flávio com Vorcaro
item.description: TSE President Nunes Marques suspended an AtlasIntel electoral poll that included audio of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro requesting money from banker Daniel Vorcaro, following a PL party request. The decision was based on indications of methodological compromise in the poll, which showed declining vote intentions for Flávio against Lula. The firm must withdraw the poll from its channels and refrain from republishing it pending review by the TSE plenary.

item.title: Kassio manda tirar do ar pesquisa que mostrou recuo de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques ordered the suspension of the Atlas/Bloomberg poll showing a six-point drop in Flávio Bolsonaro's voting intentions in a potential runoff against Lula. The decision, made on Monday (August 8), aims to uphold electoral integrity by preventing the release of data deemed potentially harmful or unverified.

item.title: Kassio suspende pesquisa AtlasIntel que apontou queda de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques has suspended the dissemination of an AtlasIntel poll showing a seven-point drop in Flávio Bolsonaro's voting intentions against Lula, granting a preliminary injunction requested by the senator. The decision cites concerns over methodological neutrality, as the poll included audio of Flávio Bolsonaro's conversation with Daniel Vorcaro after voting questions, potentially influencing respondents. The measure is not final and will be reviewed by the TSE plenary.

item.title: Ancelotti pode ser o primeiro técnico estrangeiro campeão da Copa do Mundo
item.description: Carlo Ancelotti, the Italian coach of the Brazilian national team, could become the first foreign manager to win the World Cup, as all previous champions were led by coaches of the same nationality. In 2026, 27 of the 48 teams will be managed by foreigners, up from just 9 in 2022, significantly increasing the odds of breaking this historical trend. Alongside Ancelotti, top contenders like Roberto Martínez (Portugal) and Thomas Tuchel (England) are also in the running, while Brazil will have no Brazilian head coach for the first time ever.

item.title: Kassio Nunes Marques determina suspensão de pesquisa que apontou queda de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques ordered the suspension and removal of an AtlasIntel poll showing a five-point drop in Flávio Bolsonaro’s voting intentions, following a PL petition. The ruling claims the survey’s questionnaire induced negative responses by sequencing eight questions about Banco Master and Daniel Vorcaro, creating an accusatory context that undermined methodological integrity. The decision will be referred to the TSE plenary for review on Tuesday (9).

item.title: Ala de tribunal militar deve rever provas do STF para manter patente de condenados da trama golpista
item.description: A faction within the Superior Military Court (STM) will review the evidence from the 2022 coup plot case to attempt to retain the military ranks of generals Augusto Heleno and Paulo Sérgio Nogueira, central figures in the case. The goal is to prevent the loss of their military status by reassessing the evidence presented by the Federal Supreme Court (STF). The move comes amid political pressure to preserve the positions of officers involved in the attempted coup.

item.title: PSDB busca alianças para manter candidatura de Paulo Serra ao governo de SP
item.description: The PSDB is seeking alliances with parties such as the Christian Democracy, Solidarity, Mission, and Avante to make viable the pre-candidacy of Paulo Serra for governor of São Paulo, emphasizing the need to expand TV airtime and local leadership support. The tucano candidacy is seen as a potential factor that could influence the likelihood of a runoff, which benefits the PT, while a faction within the PSDB-Cidadania federation prefers to back Tarcísio de Freitas’ re-election. Time is cited as the main challenge, as official electoral propaganda begins on August 16, leaving little room to build voter awareness and campaign structure.

item.title: Os três desafios de Flávio Bolsonaro para chegar ao fim da Copa
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro faces three main challenges to solidify his candidacy in the 2026 elections: maintaining support from the Bolsonarist base, overcoming ongoing investigations against him, and building a political platform that extends beyond his father’s legacy. The text emphasizes that his trajectory depends on balancing familial loyalty with political autonomy, avoiding being seen merely as an extension of classic Bolsonarism. Without overcoming these obstacles, his path toward the 'end of the Cup' — a metaphor for the conclusion of the 2026 electoral cycle — remains uncertain.

item.title: Oposição reúne 19 assinaturas para CPI do Master na Alesp
item.description: State deputy Guilherme Cortez (Psol-SP) said the opposition has gathered 19 of the 23 signatures needed to install a CPI in Alesp to investigate possible links between Banco Master and São Paulo municipalities. The probe could extend to the state government, particularly due to a R$2 million donation to Tarcísio de Freitas’ 2022 campaign by Fabiano Zettel, brother-in-law of Daniel Vorcaro and identified by the PF as an operator in the case. Cortez emphasized that privatization, especially of Sabesp, will be central in the electoral debate and criticized the left for underestimating the political relevance of São Paulo’s countryside.

item.title: Lula sanciona a criação do Dia Nacional do Enfrentamento da Dor Crônica
item.description: President Lula signed into law the establishment of National Day for Chronic Pain Awareness and Response, to be observed on July 5, featuring annual public information campaigns. The law guarantees the right to comprehensive care through the Unified Health System (SUS) for individuals suffering from chronic pain, defined as pain lasting more than three months. Health Minister Alexandre Padilha co-signed the measure, which was published in the Official Gazette.

item.title: Nesta semana, quatro legendas exibem propaganda partidária
item.description: Four political parties — PL, PT, PSD, and União Brasil — are airing party propaganda on Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday between 7:30 PM and 10:30 PM, according to the 2026 electoral calendar. PL will have six minutes total (2 minutes per day), while PSD will have five and a half minutes (2 minutes Tuesday, 1.5 minutes Thursday, 2 minutes Saturday). Party propaganda is only permitted in the first half of election years.

item.title: Governo Lula impõe sigilo de até 100 anos a processos de bets
item.description: The Lula government has imposed up to 100 years of secrecy on processes authorizing the operation of betting houses, such as 1xBet, citing personal data protection and lack of anonymization mechanisms in documents. The denial of access under the Access to Information Law prevents scrutiny of the authorization process and ultimate beneficiaries, including companies that previously operated illegally in Brazil.

item.title: Lei institui o Julho Laranja para conscientizar sobre saúde ortodôntica infantil
item.description: Law 15.424/2026 establishes Orange July as a national campaign to raise awareness about the importance of annual orthodontic evaluations for children aged 6 to 12, aiming to prevent and correct dental arch alterations, promote integral health and psychological well-being. The law provides for dissemination actions, public-private partnerships, and inclusion in the country's official events calendar. It originated from Bill PL 2.888/2021, reported by Senator Damares Alves.

item.title: O erro de gastar demais em ano eleitoral é também dos estados. Veja os piores casos e o bom exemplo
item.description: The increase in public spending during election years is not limited to the federal government but also occurs in states, as highlighted by economist Mansueto Almeida. A GLOBO report reveals the worst cases of excessive state spending and points to a positive example of fiscal discipline. The content is available only to GLOBO subscribers.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Alcolumbre indicará ritmo da PEC da 6×1 no Senado em semana decisiva para o governo Lula
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre will set the pace for the PEC ending the 6×1 work schedule in a leaders’ meeting this week, indicating support only for reducing the weekly workload from 44 to 40 hours, not necessarily changing the work scale itself. He resisted pressure to rush the vote, stating the Senate should not be a 'rubber stamp' and that senators must improve the text, despite broad support for the proposal. His stance may delay Lula’s goal of delivering results before the 2026 elections, as he refuses to follow the government’s timetable and criticized the electoral timing, even though he is not running for office in October.
